lines.text: There it is. Meridian Labs, right across the harbor.

text.cadet: But OMNI parked big trucks all over the bridge. We can't drive past.
text.recruit: And there's OMNI's welcome party. They blocked the whole bridge with convoy trucks. No way around.

lines.text: So we go over. My car can jump it, if the numbers work.

text.cadet: The thrusters have to push up harder than the car weighs. Or we don't fly.
text.recruit: The thrusters have to push up harder than gravity pulls down. If they don't, we roll off the ramp and drop.
text.operative: Lift has to beat weight: thrust ÷ weight over 1. Under that, the ramp is all the height we get.

lines.text: So first, learn how thrust works. Then test a few designs in the Lab.
Then we take our shot. One shot. Thrust up, nose level, land it like a feather.
